column2: intro]
I've got my notebooks, I've got my pen,
I’m ready to write, like a snail in its den,
Jotting down words, and whimsical thoughts,
On these blank pages, my pen’s joyful knots.
Write, write, it’s my delight,
On my notebooks, I let it all take flight,
With humorous words, I’ll share and play,
With you, I want to create every day.
In my notebooks, I've got secret dreams,
Wordplay and tales, and silly schemes,
I shape the language, play with each line,
To make you laugh, that’s my sweet design.
Write, write, it’s my delight,
On my notebooks, I let it all take flight,
With humorous words, I’ll share and play,
With you, I want to create every day.
